name: R2021 Regulation (CBCS)
description: Anna University R2021 Regulation — 80 marks end semester + 20 marks internal, 5 units, 10-credit semester system, outcome-based education

in_semester.name: Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA)
in_semester.notes: CIA includes two internal assessment tests (CAT1 and CAT2) weighted at 20%. Each test covers 2.5 units.

instructions: Answer ALL questions from PART A (10 × 2 = 20 marks).
Answer any FIVE full questions from PART B (5 × 13 = 65 marks) with internal choice.
Choose either (a) or (b) for each question in Part B.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.
Figures to the right indicate full marks.

question_structure.description: Part A: 10 compulsory 2-mark questions (all 5 units). Part B: 5 OR-pairs, one per unit, each 13 marks with sub-questions.
question_structure.labeling: Q1-Q10 (Part A), Q11/Q12 (Unit 1), Q13/Q14 (Unit 2), Q15/Q16 (Unit 3), Q17/Q18 (Unit 4), Q19/Q20 (Unit 5)
